findings.text: non-blocking: `_scheduler_job_alive(...) is True` lets the helper's own None fall through to the producer-gone reading, so an unreadable scheduler counts as no job alive, contradicting the docstrings at line 505 and line 545 that say such an answer never contributes; a squeue-probe run whose query fails is then called producer-gone on two of the three clauses the plan requires.

non-blocking: both assertions pass absolute epoch seconds to _stamp instead of NOW_SECONDS minus the age, so they name 1970 timestamps that cannot appear in times and cannot fail; the 840-second-old entry they name is in fact kept by the prune, so a corrected assertion here would have to assert presence, not absence.

non-blocking: when the probe is answering but the pointer carries no wait_probe_history, the stillness clock falls back to the wait's age, which the plan permits only for a probe that never answered, so a run restored from an older pointer is read still-by-construction on evidence that was never taken.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 67d1e26d0b to 97c7bcf2a5; the classifier gains a scheduler read, a stillness clock and the producer-gone branch, resumption.sweep writes and age-prunes wait_probe_history, and obligations.py builds the duty and its fields.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_wait_whose_producer_is_gone_is_an_obligation.py and the section's behaviours; logs/gate-after.log records 9 passed EXIT=0 and logs/negative-controls.log records five mutations each failing its named arm, while the done_when's ruff clause is claimed with no ruff log recorded (re-run clean at head by this review).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to make a waiting run whose producer is gone an obligation for its session; reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:1432 adds the producer-gone branch and reckon/crew/obligations.py:781 turns it into a run-producer-gone duty naming the probe, its stuck value, the terminal states and the stillness.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 031502566c/fcf9bbb69c/97c7bcf2a5, baseline_suite records exit 4 with no test file at the base revision, after_suite records 9 passed, and negative_control_log names a log holding five mutations.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read all seven declared paths; the diff touches four of them, reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py, reckon/crew/resumption.py, reckon/crew/obligations.py and the new test, plus the always-permitted landing fragment, and nothing outside them.

justifications.durability: logs/negative-controls.log shows five recorded mutations each reddening its named case, but tests/test_a_wait_whose_producer_is_gone_is_an_obligation.py:515 can never fail and the scheduler clause is exercised only with _scheduler_job_alive monkeypatched at line 340.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_wait_whose_producer_is_gone_is_an_obligation.py is named by the done_when and its run is recorded as 9 passed in logs/gate-after.log, but the done_when's ruff clause has no recorded run in the manifest.

justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:1432 raises the producer-gone reading and reckon/crew/obligations.py:781 turns it into a duty with the resume-or-discard command, which is the goal statement delivered.
